title: First-coordinate slice of the noise operator
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $\rho\in\mathbb R$, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube, and let $b\in\{\pm1\}$. The slice at first coordinate $b$ of the noise operator applied to $f$ equals, as a function of $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, $b\rho$ times the noise operator applied to the odd part of $f$, plus the noise operator applied to its even part.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube
